name: claudetto-docs
description: Gets current library and API docs from the Context7 MCP server, or with the Context7 CLI `ctx7`. Works with no key, and keeps an optional key in secure storage.

CONTEXT7_API_KEY.title: Context7 API Key
CONTEXT7_API_KEY.description: Optional. The key raises the quota of Context7. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage and sends it only in the header of the `context7` server.
